title: 第15章 《解放军文艺》
content_zh:
第15章 《解放军文艺》-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

燕京，西城区地安门西什库茅屋胡同甲3号院。这里是《解放军文艺》杂志编辑部的所在地，《解放军文艺》杂志属于解放军总政管辖，这里单独划给编辑部使用，总政机关还在距离这里五六公里的黄寺大院。
刘济民想了很久，还是决定将《童年的朋友》投给《解放军文艺》。此时的地方刊物《人民文艺》、《燕京文学》等大多热衷于发表伤痕文学作品，刊登的军旅题材作品极少，刘济民怕被压了下来。
当然，论在社会上的影响力，《人民文艺》这类地方刊物还是首屈一指的。《解放军文艺》的文章在军内具有巨大的影响力，现如今军队文娱生活有限，看报纸看杂志就是娱乐。军队的报纸和杂志，自然是各一线部队订购首选。
《解放军文艺》杂志门口，身穿绿军装的工作人员来来往往，刘济民找到门口的门卫，笑着说道：“老班长，我想投稿，您看放哪儿合适？”
大爷抬头看了眼刘济民身上的军装，散光的眼神仿佛瞬间连上了蓝牙——聚焦成功，脸上也多了几分笑意：“小同志，你是哪个单位的？”
“我是医学科学院的学生，闲来没事，写了点东西，想着投稿。咱们当兵的稿子，自然要投给咱们《解放军文艺》。我看地址也不远，于是就骑着自行车儿过来了。”刘济民笑着解释道，从口袋里掏出了包烟。
大爷接过刘济民的烟，严肃地说道：“写东西可不是解闷儿，这是艺术。不过有句话你没说错，《解放军文艺》就是咱当兵的家。”
“对对对，您批评的对，您看我这稿子？”
宰相门前七品官，刘济民只得顺着大爷的话说了下去。
“放这儿吧，一会儿有人过来收信。”大爷这才满意地吸了口烟。
“得嘞，您继续休息！”
“你这小同志，我还得批评你几句，我这是岗哨，这栋楼的保卫工作都由我负责，保护一方平安。”
“好嘞，老班长，您继续保卫一方平安，我先走了！”刘济民腹诽，刚才坐那儿都快睡着了。这一方平安要靠你保护，早就完犊子了。
等刘济民走后，老班长笑眯眯地望着刘济民的背影，忽然咂巴了一下烟头，嘟囔道：“好好的烟，怎么潮了。”
回到宿舍，又是空无一人。刘济民掏空口袋算了一下钱，上次稿费八块钱，刘济民现在总共有十一块钱。
也不知道《解放军文艺》什么时候能够看到自己的稿子并刊登，刘济民迫切需要稿费改善生活。

Chapter 15 "Literature and Art of the People's Liberation Army" - "Literary Hero 1978: Beginning as a Military Writer"

Yanjing, No. 3 Courtyard A, Xishiku Maowu Hutong, Di'anmen, Xicheng District. This is the location of the editorial department of the "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" magazine. The "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" magazine is under the jurisdiction of the General Administration of the People's Liberation Army. This place is separately designated for the use of the editorial department. The general administration organs are still in the Huangsi compound five or six kilometers away from here.
Liu Jimin thought for a long time and decided to vote for "Childhood Friends" to "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art". At this time, local publications such as "People's Literature and Art" and "Yenjing Literature" were mostly keen on publishing scar literature, and very few military-themed works were published. Liu Jimin was afraid of being suppressed.
Of course, in terms of social influence, local publications like People's Literature and Art are second to none. Articles in "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" have huge influence within the military. Nowadays, military entertainment life is limited. Reading newspapers and magazines is entertainment. Military newspapers and magazines are naturally the first choice for ordering by front-line troops.
At the door of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" magazine, staff members in green military uniforms came and went. Liu Jimin found the guard at the door and said with a smile: "Old squad leader, I want to submit an article. Do you think where can I put it?"
The uncle raised his head and glanced at Liu Jimin's military uniform. His astigmatic eyes seemed to be instantly connected to Bluetooth - the focus was successful, and there was a bit of a smile on his face: "Little comrade, which unit are you from?"
"I am a student at the Academy of Medical Sciences. I had nothing to do, so I wrote something and thought about submitting it. The manuscript for us soldiers will naturally be submitted to our "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art". I saw that the address was not far away, so I rode a bicycle over here." Liu Jimin explained with a smile and took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket.
The uncle took the cigarette from Liu Jimin and said seriously: "Writing is not a way to relieve boredom, it is art. But you are right, "PLA Literature and Art" is our home as soldiers."
"Yes, yes, your criticism is correct. Do you want to read my manuscript?"
Liu Jimin, a seventh-rank official in front of the prime minister, had no choice but to follow the uncle's words.
"Put it here, someone will come over to collect the letter later." The uncle then took a puff of cigarette with satisfaction.
"Okay, you can continue to rest!"
"You little comrade, I have to criticize you a few words. I am a sentry, and I am responsible for the security of this building to protect everyone's safety."
"Okay, old squad leader, you continue to protect the safety of the party, I'll leave first!" Liu Jimin cursed, almost falling asleep just sitting there. The safety of this place depends on your protection, and it has been over for a long time.
After Liu Jimin left, the old squad leader looked at Liu Jimin's back with a smile, suddenly smacked the cigarette butt, and muttered: "It's such a good cigarette, why is it so wet?"
When I returned to the dormitory, it was empty again. Liu Jimin took out his pocket and counted the money. The last royalties were eight yuan, and Liu Jimin now had a total of eleven yuan.
I don't know when "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" will see his manuscript and publish it. Liu Jimin urgently needs the royalties to improve his life.
